profiles.aboutMe:
"I graduated with a degree in Computer Science from NIT Jaipur and have spent the last four years working as a software engineer, primarily focusing on backend architecture and distributed systems. I enjoy solving complex performance bottlenecks and collaborating across cross-functional teams.

Outside of work, I come from a service-oriented family in Jaipur. My father spent his career in public sector banking with SBI, and my mother is a high school mathematics teacher. Growing up in a household that placed a strong emphasis on discipline, lifelong learning, and steady problem-solving naturally shaped my work ethic and analytical mindset. My younger sister is currently pursuing her MBA, so continuous growth is a common theme in our family."
